messages.author: 79bcfa41a91c2456
messages.subject: Covariance matrix
parts:
Hi All,

Is it possible to pass a covariance matrix to advanced.procD.lm e.g. PCov=vcv(corPagel(1,phy_chron))? The help suggests it is an option and procD.lm runs fine but I keep getting the following error:

Error in C[id, id] : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable

Thanks,
Charles

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Covariance matrix
parts:
Charles,

This error suggests the names of your covariance matrix and data matrix might not match exactly (often caused by an extra space somewhere).

Mike

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Covariance matrix
parts:
Hi Mike,

I did check that with the names as they are returned after Procrustes fit, and then again on a two dim array of PCA scores. The names appear to all be correct:

Procrustes residuals names
dimnames(P1.MEAN.coords_phy)[[3]]==dimnames(PCov)[[2]]
[1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE
dimnames(P1.MEAN.coords_phy)[[3]]==dimnames(PCov)[[1]]
[1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE

row.names(P1.phy_gdf$shape) == dimnames(PCov)[[2]]
[1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE


I get the error whether I run advanced.procD.lm with geomorph.data.frame or just with the variables. ProcD.lm works just fine with same variables.

Cheers,
Charles

I see the issue.  The function worked if ones provided a tree and asked it to calculate the phylogenetic VCV but not if one provided the VCV.  The latter was because of a typo, which has now been fixed and updated on Github.

Mike
